title: Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks for Shape Constrained Learning and Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2604.26942v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs), a novel neural network architecture designed for learning convex functions. HyCNNs combine the principles of Maxout networks with input convex neural networks (ICNNs) to create a neural network that is always convex in the input, theoretically capable of leveraging depth, and performs reliably when trained at scale compared to ICNNs. Concretely, we prove that HyCNNs require exponentially fewer parameters than ICNNs to approximate quadratic functions up to a given precision. Throughout a series of synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that HyCNNs outperform existing ICNNs and MLPs in terms of predictive performance for convex regression and interpolation tasks. We further apply HyCNNs to learn high-dimensional optimal transport maps for synthetic examples and for single-cell data, where they oftentimes outperform ICNN-based neural optimal transport methods and other baselines a

translated_title: 用于形状约束学习与最优传输的超输入凸神经网络
translated_abstract: 我们提出了超输入凸神经网络，这是一种为学习凸函数而设计的新型神经网络架构。HyCNN 将 Maxout 网络的原理与输入凸神经网络（ICNN）相结合，构建出一种在输入上始终保持凸性的神经网络，理论上能够利用网络深度，并且与 ICNN 相比在大规模训练时表现更加可靠。具体而言，我们证明了在给定精度下逼近二次函数时，HyCNN 所需的参数数量比 ICNN 呈指数级减少。通过一系列合成实验，我们证明了 HyCNN 在凸回归和插值任务的预测性能上优于现有的 ICNN 和多层感知机（MLP）。我们进一步将 HyCNN 应用于学习合成示例和单细胞数据的高维最优传输映射，在这些任务中，它们通常优于基于 ICNN 的神经最优传输方法以及其他基线方法。
tldr: HyCNN 结合 Maxout 网络与输入凸神经网络，以指数级更少的参数实现高效凸函数学习，在凸回归、插值以及高维最优传输任务中显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: HyCNNs combine Maxout networks with input convex neural networks, achieving exponentially fewer parameters for convex function learning while outperforming existing methods in convex regression, interpolation, and high-dimensional optimal transport tasks.
